notes.title: Update version 0.8.1 Oculus arrival
notes.content:
1. Support for Oculus devices perfectly.
2. Brand new backpack system: belt.
3. Add a small robot which can accompany and guide you.
4. Brand new beginer guidance system.
5. Scene Update: Add a lot of dynamic effects and atmosphere elements.
6. Repair lots of inconvenient operations.
7. Cancel the energy which used to teleport.
8. Increased the function of change weapons when both hands near.
9. Adjusting the difficulty of levels.
10. Increased the blood bar of the boss.
11. Increases the smooth move speed.
12. Fixed the problem of the flying monster wearing the wall.
13. Fixed some bugs.

Multiple versions are being developed,if you have any Suggestions, please tell us and we will try to make it better.
